about.subtitle: AI-Powered Car Pricing for Iraq & Kurdistan
about.founderStatus: AI & Data Science Student · Digital Creator
about.founderBioEn: I'm Dyar Abdulla Ali, a 20-year-old AI & Data Science student from Sulaymaniyah, Kurdistan, Iraq. I built CarWiseIQ to solve a real problem — the lack of transparency in the Iraqi car market. As a passionate developer and AI enthusiast, I spent over 4 months working 8–16 hours daily to create this platform. CarWiseIQ uses advanced machine learning trained on 62,000+ real car listings from Iraq to provide accurate, data-driven price predictions. My mission is to help every buyer and seller in Iraq make informed decisions with confidence.
about.founderBioKu: من دیار عبداللە علی، قوتابیی ٢٠ ساڵانی زانستی داتا و زیرەکی دەستکرد لە سلێمانی، کوردستان، عێراق. من CarWiseIQ دروستکردم بۆ چارەسەرکردنی کێشەیەکی ڕاستەقینە — نەبوونی ڕوونی لە بازاڕی ئۆتۆمبێلی عێراق. وەک گەشەپێدەرێکی بەئارەزوو و حەزکاری زیرەکی دەستکرد، زیاتر لە ٤ مانگم بەکارهێنا ڕۆژانە ٨–١٦ کاتژمێر بۆ دروستکردنی ئەم پلاتفۆرمە. CarWiseIQ فێربوونی ئامێری پێشکەوتوو بەکاردەهێنێت کە لەسەر ٦٢،٠٠٠+ ڕیکلامی ئۆتۆمبێلی ڕاستەقینە لە عێراق ڕاهێنراوە بۆ پێشکەشکردنی نرخی وردی داتا-بنەڕەت. ئامانجەکەم یارمەتیدانی هەموو کڕیار و فرۆشیارێکە لە عێراق بۆ بڕیاری ئاگادارانە بە متمانە.
about.founderBioAr: أنا ديار عبدالله علي، طالب علوم البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي بعمر ٢٠ عاماً من السليمانية، كوردستان، العراق. قمت ببناء CarWiseIQ لحل مشكلة حقيقية — عدم الشفافية في سوق السيارات العراقي. كمطور شغوف ومهتم بالذكاء الاصطناعي، أمضيت أكثر من ٤ أشهر أعمل ٨–١٦ ساعة يومياً لإنشاء هذه المنصة. يستخدم CarWiseIQ تعلم آلي متقدم مدرب على أكثر من ٦٢,٠٠٠ إعلان سيارات حقيقي من العراق لتقديم تنبؤات أسعار دقيقة تعتمد على البيانات. مهمتي هي مساعدة كل مشترٍ وبائع في العراق على اتخاذ قرارات واثقة.
about.techAIValue: Machine Learning models for price prediction
about.visionText: Our roadmap includes launching a mobile app within the next year, expanding our AI capabilities, and continuing to serve the growing automotive market in Iraq and Kurdistan.
about.storyText:
CarWiseIQ was born from a simple idea: bring transparency to the Iraqi car market using AI technology. As an AI & Data Science student, I saw an opportunity to solve a real problem - helping buyers and sellers make informed decisions with accurate, data-driven valuations.

What started as a university project became a passion. Over 4 months of intense development - often working 8-16 hours daily - CarWiseIQ evolved into a full platform serving the Iraqi and Kurdistan automotive community.

q1.question: How do I get my car valued?
q1.answer: Simply click 'Get Price Now' on the homepage, enter your car's details (make, model, year, mileage, condition, etc.), and our AI will provide an instant price estimate based on real market data.

q2.question: Is CarWiseIQ free to use?
q2.answer: Yes! CarWiseIQ is completely free to use. You can get unlimited price predictions, browse listings, and use all features without any cost or subscription.

q3.question: How do I contact a seller?
q3.answer: When viewing a car listing, you'll see the seller's contact information (phone number and/or WhatsApp). You can also use the messaging feature to communicate directly through the platform.

q4.question: How long do listings stay active?
q4.answer: Listings remain active until you manually remove them or mark them as sold. There's no expiration date, so your listing will stay visible to buyers until you update it.

q5.question: Is my information safe?
q5.answer: Yes, we take your privacy seriously. Your personal information is protected according to our Privacy Policy. We never share your data with third parties without your consent.

q6.question: What if I encounter a scam?
q6.answer: If you encounter a suspicious listing or user, please report it immediately using the 'Report a Problem' option. We review all reports and take action against fraudulent activity.

q7.question: How accurate are the AI valuations?
q7.answer: On validation data we see about 96% R²—strong fit on the training distribution. Valuations are still estimates: real prices depend on condition, negotiation, and demand.

q8.question: Can I edit my listing after posting?
q8.answer: Yes! You can edit your listing at any time by going to 'My Listings' in your account dashboard. You can update photos, price, description, and other details.

q1.question: Is this really free?
q1.answer: Yes! 100% free forever. No credit card, no subscription, no hidden fees. We believe everyone should have access to accurate car price predictions.

q2.question: How accurate are the predictions?
q2.answer: On validation data our model reaches about 96% R²—meaning it explains most of the price variation in the training set. Real-world prices still depend on condition, negotiation, and timing, so treat every figure as a guide.

q3.question: Do I need to create an account?
q3.answer: No! You can use all features without signing up. However, creating a free account lets you save your predictions and compare cars later.

q4.question: What data do you use?
q4.answer: We train on 62,000+ cleaned listing records (prices, years, mileage, make/model, condition, fuel type, and location fields) aggregated for the Iraqi and Kurdish markets.

q5.question: Can I predict prices for multiple cars?
q5.answer: Yes! Use our batch processing feature to upload a CSV file with multiple cars and get predictions for all of them at once.

q6.question: Is my data secure?
q6.answer: Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption and never share your data with third parties. Your privacy is our priority.

questions.question: How is my personal data protected?
questions.answer: We use industry-standard encryption for data transmission, secure servers and databases, regular security audits, and limit employee access to personal data. However, no online system is 100% secure.

questions.question: Can I delete my account and all my data?
questions.answer: Yes, you can delete your account by contacting support at carwise15@gmail.com. Your data will be deleted within 60 days, except where legal requirements require longer retention.

questions.question: Who can see my phone number in car listings?
questions.answer: Your phone number is visible to all users when you create a car listing. This allows potential buyers to contact you directly about your vehicle.

questions.question: Do you share my information with other companies?
questions.answer: We do NOT sell your personal information. We only share information with third-party service providers (Google Maps, payment gateways, cloud storage) necessary to operate our platform, and as required by Iraqi law.

questions.question: How do you use my location data?
questions.answer: We use location data to show nearby cars, improve search results, and provide location-based services. You can disable location services in your device settings, though this may limit some platform functionality.

questions.question: Can I opt-out of marketing emails?
questions.answer: Yes, you can opt-out of marketing emails via your profile settings or by clicking the unsubscribe link in any marketing email we send you.

questions.question: How long do you keep my data after I delete my account?
questions.answer: After account deletion, we retain your data for 60 days (grace period), then permanently delete it. Exception: Transaction records are kept for 7 years for legal/tax purposes.

questions.question: What happens to my car listing photos?
questions.answer: Your car listing photos are stored securely on our cloud servers, used for your listings and anonymized AI training. When you delete your account, all photos are permanently deleted within 60 days.

questions.question: Do you use my data to train AI?
questions.answer: Yes, we use anonymized data to train our AI pricing models and improve platform features. Personal identifiers are removed before data is used for AI training.

questions.question: How do I exercise my privacy rights?
questions.answer: You can exercise your privacy rights by accessing your profile settings or contacting us directly at carwise15@gmail.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days.

q1.question: Is CarWiseIQ free to use?
q1.answer: Yes, posting listings and browsing cars is completely free. There are no fees or commissions.

q2.question: Do I need to verify my phone number?
q2.answer: No, phone verification is not required, but it's recommended for account security and buyer/seller trust.

q3.question: How many accounts can I create?
q3.answer: You can create up to 3 accounts from the same IP address.

q4.question: How many cars can I list for sale?
q4.answer: Unlimited! You can post as many car listings as you want, completely free.

q5.question: How accurate is the AI valuation?
q5.answer: The AI provides estimates based on market data, but it's a suggestion only. We don't guarantee accuracy. Always do your own research.

q6.question: Does CarWiseIQ handle payments?
q6.answer: No. All transactions happen directly between buyers and sellers. We don't process payments or charge any fees.

q7.question: What if I get scammed by a buyer/seller?
q7.answer: CarWiseIQ is not responsible for transactions between users. We recommend meeting in safe public places, verifying all documents, and being cautious. Report suspicious users to us.

q8.question: Can my account be banned?
q8.answer: Yes, accounts can be banned for fraudulent listings, harassment, scams, or any prohibited activities listed in our terms.

q9.question: Can you use my car photos?
q9.answer: Yes, when you post content, you give us permission to use your photos for marketing and AI training, but you still own them.

q10.question: How long do my listings stay active?
q10.answer: Listings remain active until you sell the car or remove them manually.

q11.question: What if someone posts a fake listing?
q11.answer: Report it immediately. We review and remove suspicious or fraudulent listings.

q12.question: Can I trust the AI price?
q12.answer: Use it as a guide, but verify with market research. Actual prices depend on condition, demand, and negotiation.

q13.question: Is CarWiseIQ responsible if my car has problems after I buy it?
q13.answer: No. Buyers are responsible for inspecting vehicles before purchase. We only connect buyers and sellers.

q14.question: Can CarWiseIQ shut down at any time?
q14.answer: Yes, we reserve the right to modify or discontinue the platform, though we would try to provide notice.

blog.subtitle: Expert advice for buying and selling cars in Iraq & Kurdistan
blog.post1: How to know used car value
blog.post2: 10 important things before buying a car
blog.content1: Understanding used car value requires checking market prices, vehicle condition, mileage, and regional demand. CarWiseIQ uses AI to analyze thousands of listings and give you an accurate estimate.
blog.content2: Before buying: 1) Get a vehicle history check, 2) Inspect for accidents, 3) Test drive, 4) Check maintenance records, 5) Verify ownership, 6) Get a pre-purchase inspection, 7) Compare prices, 8) Negotiate, 9) Understand total cost, 10) Use CarWiseIQ for valuation.
blog.content3: Popular family cars in Kurdistan include Toyota Camry, Hyundai Sonata, Kia Optima, and Nissan Altima. These offer reliability, space, and good resale value in the regional market.
